title: The Shrine of Feet
text: A shrine hung with the worn shoes of a thousand pilgrims, dangling from every beam and branch, swaying, creaking. Leave yours, the monks say, and walk on blessed. Their own feet are bare and black and hard as horn.

options.label: Leave your shoes on the beams, and walk on blessed.

outcomes.text: Blessed, and barefoot, and the road is very hard.

options.label: Keep your shoes. The road ahead is long.

outcomes.text: The monks shake their heads, and a thousand shoes creak overhead.
